Revelations in Fall#000.src: They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
Revelations in Fall#000.dst: Podían ser peligrosos. A veces lo eran. Pero casi siempre eran héroes. Usaban su poder para proteger a quien lo necesitaba.

Revelations in Fall#002.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#002.dst: Asiste a la reunión en el campamento de la resistencia en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#003.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: Hola a todos. Gracias por estar hoy aquí.
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: Cada vez está más claro que desde aquí podemos hacer muy poco para influir de verdad en Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: ¡Hemos hecho el bien por la gente de Auburn! Pero nuestros recursos son limitados, y nuestras ocasiones de actuar aún más.
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: Además, el riesgo de operar crece cada día. No me arrepiento de aceptar a {u} como miembro, pero no es ningún secreto que tenerlo aquí atrae más vigilancia.
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: Zeph y {u} supieron ayer que un Inquisidor viene a la zona. No sabemos a qué exactamente, pero su presencia pone nuestra causa en más peligro.
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: En el festival recibí noticias de un contacto en Roughworks. Allí hay un grupo parecido al nuestro, dirigido por un viejo amigo mío. Se llaman la Pluma de Acero.
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#009.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: Tienen recursos que nosotros no, y están en una posición mucho más favorable. Si logramos cruzar a Roughworks, han accedido a acogernos y a ayudarnos a planear los siguientes pasos.
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#010.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: ¿Y cuáles son esos pasos? No sé qué esperas que hagamos allí que no podamos hacer ya aquí.
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#011.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: Aún estoy puliendo ideas, pero tienen que ver con el Festival de la Corona. Si nos damos prisa, lo alcanzaremos en Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#012.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: Claro que viajar a otro distrito trae sus propios riesgos y peligros... si alguno quiere quedarse aquí, respetaré esa decisión.
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#013.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: ¡Ja! ¿Y dejar que trace usted los planes sola? Ya preveía algo así, de modo que lo he arreglado en el trabajo. La acompaño, señorita.
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#014.src: An I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: Y yo desde luego no me quedo fuera, ¿bromeas? Te sigo adonde vayas, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#015.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: ¡Y- yo también voy! ¿De qué sirve te- tener magia si no la uso por nuestra c- c- causa?
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#016.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#016.dst: Eh. La verdad, Synny, no me veo sirviendo de mucho ahí fuera. Y digo yo que alguien tendrá que guardar la casa mientras no estáis. Así que me quedo.
Revelations in Fall#016.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#017.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#017.dst: Te lo agradecería, Kaio. Me iré más tranquila sabiendo que Hojas al Viento queda a tu cuidado.
Revelations in Fall#017.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#020.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: Necesitaréis mi medicina. Así que voy...
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#021.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you
Revelations in Fall#021.dst: Sui... puedes quedarte, si quieres. No quiero obligarte
Revelations in Fall#021.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#022.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#022.dst: ¡N-no! ¡Quiero ir con vosotros! Es solo... que tengo que despedirme de algunas personas. Antes de irnos.
Revelations in Fall#022.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#025.src: I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#025.dst: Estaré siempre en deuda contigo. Gracias otra vez por ofrecer tu ayuda.
Revelations in Fall#025.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#026.src: In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
Revelations in Fall#026.dst: En Wynn contamos historias de gente que usaba la magia como tú. Les salía de forma natural, y no necesitaban ningún catalizador.

Revelations in Fall#027.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: Suspiro... Ojalá pudiera negarlo. Pero tienes razón, necesito que vengas.
Revelations in Fall#027.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#028.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#028.dst: Aún tengo que prepararlo todo antes de partir- sobre todo, conseguir el paso por la frontera. Tengo un contacto al que... espero poder convencer.
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#029.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean
Revelations in Fall#029.dst: N- no estarás ha- hablando de
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#030.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#030.dst: Sí, Zeph, de eso hablo. Irá bien.
Revelations in Fall#030.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#031.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#031.dst: Los demás, preparaos también. No sé cuánto durará la ventana de oportunidad, así que aprovechad el tiempo que queda.
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#032.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#032.dst: Hmn... Zeph, ¿a qué viene esa inquietud? ¡Todos sabemos que la señorita Syndra sabe lo que hace! Si dice que lo tiene controlado, no veo razón para dudar de ella.
Revelations in Fall#032.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#034.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#034.dst: ¡Ah, no importa! Venid, muchachos... ¡y {u}, por supuesto! Tomémonos un rato para despedirnos. ¡Al fin y al cabo, no sabemos cuándo volveremos!
Revelations in Fall#034.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#035.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#035.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#036.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#036.dst: Sui... volveremos. ¡Yo me encargo! Y sabes que en estas cosas siempre cumplo mi palabra.
Revelations in Fall#036.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#037.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#037.dst: Nos irá bien, Sui. Como siempre.
Revelations in Fall#037.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#039.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#039.dst: Habla con Zeph fuera de la base en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#041.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#041.dst: No sé si e- estoy lista para esto.
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#042.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#042.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#044.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: Es que... no me f- fío nada del Soberano, y m- m- me da miedo que le haga a- al- algo a Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: Es- es una tontería, pero... si t- tú y yo en- encontramos un modo de pasar el muro sin pedírselo d- directamente, evitaríamos un p- posible con- conflicto.
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#046.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#046.dst: Y además, tampoco tengo n- na- nada mejor que hacer...
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: So! L- let's head into town, and s- s- see if we can
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: ¡Así que! V- vamos a la ciudad y v- v- vemos si podemos
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: Eh... perdonad, s-siento interrumpir. Os oí decir que... ¿vais a la ciudad?
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#049.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: ¡Sui! S- sí, esa era la i- idea.
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#050.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: Si... si no es mucha molestia... ¿podría ir con vosotros? Yo, ah... tengo gente de la que quiero... despedirme.
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#051.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#051.dst: Ah... ¿los del Z- Zo- el Zorro Rojo?
Revelations in Fall#051.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#052.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: Es... un restaurante al que, eh, voy mucho. Los dueños son... amables. Quería darles las gracias por, ja, todo.
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#053.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#053.dst: Y está construido sobre uno de l- los árboles más al- altos de {p}... así que t- ta- también me vale para mi idea. Está jus- justo a las puertas de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#053.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#054.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: Ve al Zorro Rojo, el café de las copas, en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#055.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#055.dst: Q- quedemos todos en el café el Zo- Zorro Rojo. Está jus- jus- justo fuera de las puertas de {p}.
Revelations in Fall#055.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#057.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#057.dst: ¿Y qu- qué te parece? Bo- bonitas vistas desde aquí, ¿v- verdad?
Revelations in Fall#057.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#058.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.dst: Yo... traigo aquí a los demás muy a menudo. Sirven, eh, la mejor comida de {p}...
Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#059.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#059.dst: Sí... e- ech- echaré de menos nuestras cenas de madrugada. Je.
Revelations in Fall#059.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#061.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: S- Sui, ¿quieres... que nos qu- quedemos? Podemos
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#062.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll go find Chen on my own. You two, um, hand something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: ¡N-no! No, no, está... bien. Iré a ver a Chen yo sola. Vosotros dos, eh, teníais algo que hacer, ¿no?
Revelations in Fall#062.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#063.src: We did... uh, if y- you're sure, Sui. We'll see you l- la- later?
Revelations in Fall#063.dst: Sí... eh, si e- estás segura, Sui. ¿Nos vemos lu- lu- luego?
Revelations in Fall#063.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#064.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#064.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#065.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#065.dst: ...vale. Bueno, {u}, el mo- motivo de venir aquí... desde a- arr- desde aquí arriba llegamos bien a los te- tej- tejados.
Revelations in Fall#065.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#066.src: I w- w- I want to see if we can ge- get over the wall. If we st- stick to the roofs, we should be able to av- avoid suspicion...
Revelations in Fall#066.dst: Qu- qu- quiero ver si podemos pa- pasar el muro. Si no nos sa- salimos de los tejados, deberíamos ev- evitar sospechas...
Revelations in Fall#066.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#068.src: Follow Zeph to the tree branch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#068.dst: Sigue a Zeph hasta la rama del árbol en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!
Revelations in Fall#069.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#070.dst: Hola, Chen... ¿va bien, eh, el negocio?
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#071.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: ¡Hum, todo lo bien que cabe esperar, diría yo! El festival siempre trae una avalancha de clientes. ¿Te preparo lo de siempre?
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#072.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#072.dst: Ah. Eh... es muy amable de tu parte, pero no, hoy no. Gracias.
Revelations in Fall#072.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#073.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: Muy bien, muy bien. Ya que estás aquí, ¿puedo preguntarte si has pensado en mi oferta de trabajo?
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#074.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#074.dst: A estas alturas te sabes nuestra carta de memoria, así que de verdad creo que encajarías de maravilla.
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#076.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails !
Revelations in Fall#076.dst: Vale, pues... ¡tú s- si- sigue los rastros verdes!
Revelations in Fall#076.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#077.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#077.dst: Si te p- pierdes, vuelve aquí.
Revelations in Fall#077.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#078.src: Travel across the roof tops of {p} starting from .
Revelations in Fall#078.dst: Cruza los tejados de {p} empezando desde .

Revelations in Fall#080.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#080.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: Vale, ¡s- suerte! Re- recuerda seguir el rastro verde.
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#082.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#082.dst: Y- yo te sigo enseguida, primero ca- cal- caliento un poco.
Revelations in Fall#082.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#084.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#084.dst: V- vuelve aquí cuando quieras em- empezar otra vez.
Revelations in Fall#084.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#085.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#085.dst: Ja, ¡e- esta vez has llegado a- an- antes que yo!
Revelations in Fall#085.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#087.dst: Vale... s- saltemos al otro lado.
Revelations in Fall#087.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: ¡Aah! Yo... yo... ha- ha estado... c- ce- cerca.
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#089.dst: Eso ha sido... ha- ha sido m- magia, ¿no...? Era c- co- era como si todo mi cuerpo... q- qued- quedara envuelto en una b- br- brisa suave...
Revelations in Fall#089.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#090.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: Yo... ja. Ha- ha sido- e- e- emocionante, pero... p- pero... N- no- no hay forma de que c- cr- de que crucemos estos te- tej- tejados... con un s- su- con un susto me basta.
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: Uf... m- mejor... volvamos al Z- Zorro Rojo...
Revelations in Fall#091.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#092.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#092.dst: Vuelve al Zorro Rojo y habla con Zeph en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#093.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: Es que... n- n- no me gusta. ¡No me gusta que S- Syn- Syndra se ponga en p- peligro así!
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#094.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#094.dst: Yo... le debo mucho. Si no fuera por ella, s- s- seguiría at- atrapado en... en la c- ca- calle. Gracias a ella sigo... aquí.
Revelations in Fall#094.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#095.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: Sí... yo, eh, crecí en u- una aldea pequeña. A- acusaron a alguien de estar m- maldito, y... mi gente se negó a en- en- entregarlo sin p- p- pe- sin pelear.
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#096.dst: ...por cierto, ¿d- dónde está? C- creía que nos esperaría antes de...
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#097.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#097.dst: Ah, Zeph, ¿eres tú lo que oigo?
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: Ah, h- hola, Chen. Tengo que irme, pero ¿has visto a Sui? Ha- ha- habíamos quedado aquí.
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#099.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: Sí, Sui... se fue hace poco. Pobre niña, está claro que algo le pesa...
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: Me parece que habrá ido al estanque del sureste... ahí es donde suele ir cuando necesita aire.
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#101.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#101.dst: Ah, y- ya veo. ¡G- gracias por la ayuda!
Revelations in Fall#101.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#102.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#102.dst: Claro, lo que sea por vosotros, chicos. Pasaos pronto otra vez, ¿vale? Os haré la bandeja familiar, invita la casa.
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#103.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#103.dst: Yo... s- sí, ¡lo... lo haremos! Gracias por la in- invitación.
Revelations in Fall#103.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: ¿Podrías ir a v- ver cómo está Sui, p- por favor? Yo... no sé c- cómo ayudarla ahora mismo...
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#107.dst: A- al- algo le ronda la cabeza, pero... p- pero no me lo cuenta. He in- intentado preguntarle, pero...
Revelations in Fall#107.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#108.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#108.dst: ...pero si preguntas tú, qu- quizá te lo diga. N- no lo sé. Al- al menos merece la pena probar, ¿v- v- verdad?
Revelations in Fall#108.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#109.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: G- gracias, {u}. Chen dice que e- estaba en el estanque del sureste.
Revelations in Fall#109.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#110.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#110.dst: Reúnete con Sui junto al estanque en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#112.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#112.dst: A-ah, ¡{u}! No... eh, no esperaba verte aquí.
Revelations in Fall#112.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#113.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#113.dst: Ah... ya. Solo... necesitaba aire. Es, ja, algo abrumador. ¡D-dejar Auburn, digo! Nunca he... conocido otro sitio.
Revelations in Fall#113.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#115.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#115.dst: ¿Puedo... contarte una cosa? Yo... quería hablar contigo antes, pero, eh, no... no reuní el valor.
Revelations in Fall#115.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#117.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#117.dst: P-perdona, debería... lanzarme y ya. Q- quizá sea más fácil si te lo enseño, ja...
Revelations in Fall#117.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: Eres el primer, eh, maldito que he... visto. Y- y que todos sean tan amables con, con todo esto...
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#119.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#119.dst: Y he pensado que quizá... quizá podrías... ayudarme. A mí. A e-entenderlo todo.
Revelations in Fall#119.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#121.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#121.dst: Pero... yo no uso, eh, catalizador. Para... para controlar el agua. A-así que soy una de las... p-peligrosas. Eso... e-eso dijo Mora, eh, antes.
Revelations in Fall#121.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: Ah... m-menos mal. Eso- eso está bien. Me alegro.
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#126.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing to do for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#126.dst: Ah... eso es, ja, mucho hacer por alguien. ¿C-colarse en una provincia? No me imagino, eh, haciendo algo así...
Revelations in Fall#126.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll, h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: Solo... tengo miedo. Miedo de que- de que si intento usarla, acabe, h-hiriendo a alguien...
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#129.dst: No soy... muy valiente, jaja. En realidad no me uní a la resistencia porque... ¡porque quisiera plantar cara a la Corona!
Revelations in Fall#129.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#130.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#130.dst: Algo así se me hace... imposible.
Revelations in Fall#130.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: ... Estoy aquí solo porque seguí a Mora. ¡El valiente es él! N-no- no yo. Es que, ja, no tenía adónde ir.
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#132.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#132.dst: ¡Y- y los demás están tan ilusionados con la m-ma-magia! Hasta, eh, Mora. ¡Y yo con miedo de- de probar!
Revelations in Fall#132.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: Ya, pero... no- no me parecería, eh, bien. Si el resto de mi familia se va, ja, ¿cómo no iba a ir con ellos?
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: What if... something happened to them- to you - and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: ¿Y si... les pasara algo- o a ti - y, y, y- y yo no estuviera, allí? Nunca... ¡nunca me lo p-perdonaría!
Revelations in Fall#135.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#136.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#136.dst: Así que... a-así que, aunque tenga miedo... no puedo quedarme.
Revelations in Fall#136.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#137.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#137.dst: ...no soy, eh, muy luchadora. Pero sigo siendo buena con las m-medicinas y la curación. Así que... puedo ayudar.
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#138.dst: Vamos... a casa. Debería decirle a Zeph que estoy bien.
Revelations in Fall#138.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#139.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#139.dst: Vuelve a Hojas al Viento en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#140.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#141.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#141.dst: Yo... quiero ayudar. Solo tengo miedo.
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#142.src: Hrmm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#142.dst: Hrmm... ah, {u}, ¡justo la hoja que buscaba!
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: Casi he terminado los preparativos de la expedición. Provisiones empacadas, despedidas dichas, y demás.
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: Aunque queda... una última cosa. ¿Me permites pedirte un favor?
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: ...ah, día ajetreado, ¿me equivoco? Prometo que será rápido, si me escuchas.
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#147.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#147.dst: Ya te lo dije antes: ¡tus palabras sobre la magia calaron en mí! He sacado tiempo para practicar, con la ayuda de unas nociones superficiales sobre las bendiciones militares.
Revelations in Fall#147.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#148.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#148.dst: Pero ese entrenamiento me servirá de poco en un combate real. Así que, por mejorar, ¡te pido un combate de entrenamiento contra ti!
Revelations in Fall#148.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#149.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#149.dst: Me ayudará a detectar y reforzar mis puntos débiles. ¡Quizá a ti te sirva igual!
Revelations in Fall#149.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#150.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#153.dst: Uf... ¡debo decir que tienes mucho talento!
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#154.dst: ¡Con razón la señorita Syndra confía en ti, tras luchar contigo!
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: Y bien, dime, ¿qué tal lo he hecho?
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: ¡De veras! En el momento no sentí que tuviera muchas opciones, pero ¡supongo que aún estoy aprendiendo a manejarla!
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#157.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#157.dst: Aunque es extraño. Lo supe hace nada y, sin embargo, ¡siento que la magia ha estado conmigo desde siempre! Es como... memoria muscular, ¿no? Hay mucho en lo que pensar.
Revelations in Fall#157.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: ¡Ja! No hace falta que lo endulces. Siempre me he especializado en golpes pesados, así que sufro contra rivales veloces. ¡Rara vez he ganado a Zeph en un entrenamiento!
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: Quizá ahí esté el valor de esta magia... ¿hallar métodos para ampliar el área de efecto o ralentizar a los rivales? Hay mucho en lo que pensar.
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#160.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: Excelente pregunta, aunque no tengo respuestas ciertas. ¿Quizá se me haya quedado algo de lo aprendido en fuentes militares?
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#161.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: Confío en que a Zeph le llegará con el tiempo. ¡Es tenaz! Ese rasgo le vendrá muy bien para esto.
Revelations in Fall#161.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#162.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen- oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: ¡Eh, Mora! ¿Has visto- ah, ahí estás. Te estaba buscando.
Revelations in Fall#162.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#163.src: I had a friend... he was also from Fruma, and he was "cursed." And he was also struggling with that label, like you.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: Tenía un amigo... también era de Fruma, y estaba "maldito". Y también le pesaba esa etiqueta, como a ti.

Revelations in Fall#164.src: But he found ways to make peace with it. He used his abilities to strengthen himself and his allies. He made a difference.
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: Pero encontró la forma de hacer las paces con ello. Usó sus poderes para fortalecerse a sí mismo y a sus aliados. Cambió las cosas.

Revelations in Fall#165.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#165.dst: Vale, {u}, ven conmigo. Vamos a ACLARAR nuestros problemas antes de irnos.
Revelations in Fall#165.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#166.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#166.dst: ¡Vamos, vamos! Al tocón gigante, ¡no tengo todo el día!
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#167.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#167.dst: ... Ah. Vaya. ¡Parece que hoy está de malas! Aunque tiene sentido, dado que...
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#168.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: Hmm, ¿cómo lo diría...? Ah, déjalo. Mejor síguela hasta el árbol y mira qué quiere.
Revelations in Fall#168.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: Échale un ojo por mí, ¿quieres? Que vuelva a casa sana y salva.
Revelations in Fall#169.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#170.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#170.dst: Busca a Rex en el viejo tocón en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#171.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#171.dst: Échale un ojo a Rex, ¿quieres? Hacía tiempo que no la veía tan alterada...
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#172.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#173.dst: Mira, la cosa es así: eres un problema.
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#174.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#174.dst: ¡Claro, lo has demostrado cien veces! Una y otra y otra vez has dejado claro que estás de nuestro lado.
Revelations in Fall#174.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#175.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#175.dst: ¡Y eso es genial! ¡Genial y todo lo que quieras! Pero. ¡Pero pero pero pero pero! Sigues siendo. De. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#175.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#176.dst: O... de Fruma en origen, lo que sea. ¡Ese es el problema, en realidad! Si solo fueras de Wynn, ¡quizá no sería tan grave!
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#177.dst: ¡Hay muchísima gente de Fruma a la que embarcaron rumbo a Wynn! Les encanta mandar lejos a los niños problemáticos en cuanto no pueden con ellos.
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#178.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not- not...!
Revelations in Fall#178.dst: ¡Lo entiendo! ¡De verdad! ¡Tiene sentido! Pero aun así... por qué... ¡¿por qué estás TÚ aquí y no- no...?!
Revelations in Fall#178.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but- but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: Pues yo tenía un hermano, ¿vale? Y sí, a veces era un idiota, pero- pero era el único de allí que me entendía de verdad.
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: Él me talló el arco. Se enteró de que me interesaba el tiro con arco, así que... cuando los demás me decían que me centrara en los estudios, él me enseñó.
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: Odiaba con toda su alma las reglas que teníamos allí arriba. Así que le gustaba romperlas. Mucho. Y al final la Corona se hartó. Lo empaquetó y lo mandó a Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: ¡Y lo peor es que nuestros padres estuvieron de acuerdo! ¡Decían que le vendría bien currar de verdad!
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#186.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#186.dst: A mí tampoco me gustaba aquello. Tardé en reunir el valor, pero al final robé algo de nuestro dinero y compré un billete para ir allí.
Revelations in Fall#186.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: No hice mucho equipaje. ¡Supongo que esperaba encontrarlo y vivir con él! Qué tonta. Debí pensarlo mejor.
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#188.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#188.dst: No estaba allí, claro. Unos amigos suyos me contaron que allí siguió haciendo tonterías. La Corona lo pilló y decidió dejar de darle segundas oportunidades.
Revelations in Fall#188.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: ¡Así que ya no está! Prometió que algún día volvería a verme, y y por supuesto no cumplió. Supongo que no era lo bastante importante como para acordarse.
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#190.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#190.dst: Sí, ya lo sé. Es solo... supongo que esperaba ser la excepción.
Revelations in Fall#190.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#192.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#192.dst: No he sido muy justa contigo, ¿verdad? No es culpa tuya que tú estés aquí y él no.
Revelations in Fall#192.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#194.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#194.dst: Así que... perdona. Por todo eso.
Revelations in Fall#194.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#196.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#196.dst: Dame algo de tiempo, ¿vale? Necesito... no sé. Necesito espacio.
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#198.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#198.dst: Vale. No... tardaré mucho. Total, aquí nunca viene nadie.
Revelations in Fall#198.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#199.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#199.dst: Vuelve al campamento y acaba de hacer el equipaje en [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#201.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#201.dst: Solo espero que siga ahí fuera, en algún sitio...
Revelations in Fall#201.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#202.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#202.dst: ¡A- ahí estás! Nos, eh, preocupamos por si p- pa- pasaba algo malo.
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#203.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#203.dst: Yo... digo... e- ellos se preocuparon.
Revelations in Fall#203.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#205.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#205.dst: Solo estábamos hablando. Dioses, qué imaginación tenéis...
Revelations in Fall#205.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#207.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#207.dst: Me temo que no. No sabemos nada desde la reunión de esta mañana.
Revelations in Fall#207.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#209.dst: ¡Sigamos confiando en Syndra, como tantas otras veces! Sabe cuidarse sola.
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#210.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go
Revelations in Fall#210.dst: ¡Uf! ¡Sabía que f- fi- fiarse del Soberano e- era un error! T- t- tenemos que ir
Revelations in Fall#210.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#211.src: Excuse me- the Sovereign? What do you mean the S-
Revelations in Fall#211.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#213.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#213.dst: Suspiro... Llego un poco tarde, ya veo.
Revelations in Fall#213.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#214.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#214.dst: Bueno, ya que ha salido a la luz, me explicaré. Primero, os debo a todos una disculpa por esto.
Revelations in Fall#214.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#216.dst: Mora, no pasa nada. Iba a revelar este secreto de todos modos.
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#217.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today - it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#217.dst: El contacto que mencioné esta mañana - es el Soberano Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#217.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#219.src: What?! How long have you been- wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#219.dst: ¡¿Qué?! ¿Desde cuándo llevas- espera, Mora, ¿tú lo sabías?
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#220.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#220.dst: Fue un secreto guardado por necesidad. En cuanto a cuánto tiempo... digamos que bastante, y dejémoslo ahí. Pero nos vamos de {p}, así que ya no veo motivo para ocultarlo.
Revelations in Fall#220.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#221.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#221.dst: Sé que todos os preocupáis por mí... y hoy no quería añadir otra variable de la que inquietarse. Lo siento.
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#223.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#223.dst: Sí, los tengo. Zhiraok me dio suficientes para todos. Aunque habrá que darse prisa: quiero cruzar a Roughworks antes de que sospeche lo que pasa.
Revelations in Fall#223.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#224.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#224.dst: ...¿e- estás a salvo entonces? ¿Fue t- todo bien?
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#225.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#225.dst: Sí, Zeph, estoy a salvo. ¿Tenéis todo recogido? Cruzar la frontera llevará un rato, así que hay que salir hacia {p} ya.
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#226.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#226.dst: Vamos, deprisa. Dejemos atrás este capítulo.
Revelations in Fall#226.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#227.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at in {p}.
Revelations in Fall#227.dst: Atraviesa la puerta hacia Roughworks en  en {p}.

Revelations in Fall#229.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#229.dst: E-estoy l-listo para esto. Debo estarlo.
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#230.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#230.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#232.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#232.dst: ¡Quedemos en la puerta a Roughworks y crucemos juntos!
Revelations in Fall#232.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#233.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#233.dst: Ah... ahí estás. La, eh, cola era larguísima al llegar, así que... nos pusimos ya.
Revelations in Fall#233.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#234.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#234.dst: Todo va... bien, de momento. Creo. Eso... espero.
Revelations in Fall#234.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#239.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#239.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#244.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#244.dst: Hemos pasado. Ha ido... bastante bien.
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#245.dst: E- eso ha sido... e- estresante.
Revelations in Fall#245.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#248.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#248.dst: Ya basta, niños. Señorita Syndra, hemos llegado a Roughworks, ¿verdad?
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#249.src: We have. We'll follow the plan regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before
Revelations in Fall#249.dst: Así es. Seguiremos el plan: reagruparnos a las afueras de {p}, la ciudad de la región. Hay que darse prisa, no sé de cuánto tiempo disponemos antes de que
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#250.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#251.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#251.dst: ... Soberano. Rápido y eficiente, como siempre.
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#252.src: Naturally, you completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#252.dst: Cómo no, calculaste fatal al creer que podrías colarte así. Una variable no deseada no es una variable inesperada.
Revelations in Fall#252.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#253.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#253.dst: Valía la pena, aunque fuera improbable.
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#254.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#254.dst: Qué basura. Trasladarte a Roughworks anula por completo el pacto de la Corona... Como si no fueran a verte.
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#255.dst: ¡Aunque el que calculó mal de verdad fui yo! Tu ángulo era clarísimo, y aun así lo pasaba por alto. Seguía confiando en ti. Seguía esperando que te asentaras, que terminaras esta secuencia.
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#256.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#256.dst: Y aquí estás... ¡juntándote con un asesino en masa! ¡¡El maldito que causó la masacre de Torann!! ¡¿Qué lógica de orden ínfimo es esta?! ¡¿En qué estabas PENSANDO?!
Revelations in Fall#256.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#258.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I want Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#258.dst: ¿No es obvio, Soberano? Quiero a Su Majestad destronada. Quiero que su imperio se desmorone.
Revelations in Fall#258.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#259.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#259.dst: ¡¡Tu trabajo era infiltrarte, no sumarte a la resistencia!! ¡¿Desde cuándo te pasaste al otro lado de la ecuación?! Estás restando tu única oportunidad, estás ¡Estás tirando por la borda todo lo que he hecho por ti!
Revelations in Fall#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#260.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#260.dst: Así que después de todo lo que Ella me hizo, ¡¿esperabas que lo aceptara sin más?! ¡¿Que me conformara con las sobras, que perdonara y olvidara?!
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#261.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#261.dst: Quizá el necio fuiste tú desde el principio, Zhiraok, por creértelo.
Revelations in Fall#261.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#263.src: ...so it was all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#263.dst: ...¿entonces todo era imaginario? ¿Nada real? Yo te apreciaba, como amiga. Como confidente. ¿Y tú? ¿O... solo era una herramienta cómoda para ti?
Revelations in Fall#263.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#265.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#265.dst: Acaso... importa. ...ja. ¡¡Acaso importa!! ¿Sabes cuánto peso tenías en mis operaciones diarias? ¡¡Me pregunto cuánto tenía yo en las tuyas!!
Revelations in Fall#265.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#266.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#266.dst: No me alegra hacer esto. Tu resistencia queda detenida por el delito de conspiración contra la Corona, y tu maldito, condenado a ejecución.
Revelations in Fall#266.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#267.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still
Revelations in Fall#267.dst: Aún puedo mover algunos hilos, Syndra. Redondear todo esto. Quizá pueda dejarte dentro del resto si te entregas. Todavía podemos
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#268.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#268.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#269.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#269.dst: ...por qué... me molesto siquiera. Un maldito comparado conmigo... pura basura. Acabemos con esto.
Revelations in Fall#269.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#272.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you
Revelations in Fall#272.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#278.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just
Revelations in Fall#278.dst: En marcha. Recordad el punto de encuentro, solo
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#279.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#279.dst: ¿En serio vamos a pasar por alto que has matado a un Soberano????
Revelations in Fall#279.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#280.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long- that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#280.dst: Sí, Rex, porque no seguirá caído mucho tiempo- ¡por eso hay que moverse, ya!
Revelations in Fall#280.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#281.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#281.dst: Separaos, cuidaos, que no os pillen. Nos vemos en tres días, ¡VAMOS!
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#282.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#283.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#283.dst: Que pase, y si pudieras tramitar estos expedientes, por-favor-y-gracias. Necesito que el inquisidor opine sobre el problema.
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#284.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short
Revelations in Fall#284.dst: Tengo un valor finito de tiempo para esto, así que seamos breves
Revelations in Fall#284.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#286.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#286.dst: Hola, Soberano. Perdón por interrumpirte otra vez en horario de trabajo.
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#287.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#287.dst: ¡Lo añadiré al recuento! Y encima traes el problema directo a mi despacho. Me pone nervioso la cantidad de veces que ha pasado últimamente.
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#288.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#288.dst: Vayamos al grano, entonces. Dime cuál es tu ángulo Uf. Cuál es tu petición.
Revelations in Fall#288.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#289.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick- I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#289.dst: No te lo guardes, te saldrá una úlcera. Seré breve- necesito paso a Roughworks. Para mí y para otras cinco personas.
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#290.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#290.dst: ...me estás pidiendo la cuadratura del círculo. ¿Por qué necesitas hacer esto, ir allí? ¿Y tan de repente? ¿Por qué?
Revelations in Fall#290.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#291.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#291.dst: Yo... tengo que encontrarla. No sé cuánto tiempo más tendré para intentarlo.
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#292.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#292.dst: ¡¡Lo sé, lo sé!! ¡¡Deja de hacerte la obtusa, sabes las consecuencias de romper el mandato, para los dos!!
Revelations in Fall#292.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#294.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#294.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#296.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we If you I
Revelations in Fall#296.dst: Cómo no. Tú y tus perros callejeros. ¿Por qué no puedes...? Tiene que haber otra solución, si nosotros Si tú Yo
Revelations in Fall#296.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#298.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#298.dst: ...por qué me molesto siquiera. Está bien. Si tanto lo quieres, ¡¡está bien!! Ya sabes lo que costará. Solo... Recuerda. Recuerda lo que he hecho por ti.
Revelations in Fall#298.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#299.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#299.dst: Gracias, Zhiraok. No dejaré que tu bondad se desperdicie.
Revelations in Fall#299.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#300.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns
Revelations in Fall#300.dst: ¡Soberano Zhiraok! El Inquisidor Renn tiene algunas dudas
Revelations in Fall#300.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#301.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#301.dst: Xao, necesito que me despejes la agenda. Ahora hay una prioridad mayor, puede esperar.
Revelations in Fall#301.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#302.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top
Revelations in Fall#302.dst: ¡Ah! Eh, ¡por supuesto! ¡¡Si usted insiste, señor!! Al Inquisidor Renn no le gustará, pero sus órdenes son lo primer
Revelations in Fall#302.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#303.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#303.dst: No, tienes razón, estoy siendo irracional. Siempre tienes razón. Despeja todo menos eso, no pasa nada. Ya lo retomaré luego. Variables inesperadas, circunstancias atenuantes...
Revelations in Fall#303.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#304.src: Sov ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her
Revelations in Fall#304.dst: Sobe ...¿Zhi-Zhi? ¿Va todo bien? Se... se le ve alterado, ¿dijo ella algo? ¿No debí hacerla pasa
Revelations in Fall#304.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#305.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#305.dst: No has hecho nada malo. Al fin y al cabo, me dio una oportunidad prima. Un aviso antes de descuadrar mi secuencia.
Revelations in Fall#305.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#306.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#306.dst: Xao, confío en ti. Necesito dejar Auburn a tu cargo un tiempo mientras resuelvo esto. Por favor. ¿Podrás con ello?
Revelations in Fall#306.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#307.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#307.dst: ...vaya, yo... ¡Es un honor! ¡¡No le fallaré, señor!! ¡Lo tendré todo como los chorros del oro! Pero ¿por qué me necesita a mí para esto?
Revelations in Fall#307.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#308.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#308.dst: ...Necesito converger en Roughworks y cubrir su trabajo un tiempo. Y el Festival de la Corona está cerca. Siento que perdérmelo sería un error.
Revelations in Fall#308.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
